name: markdown2pdf
description: Standalone Markdown to PDF renderer reproducing Typora 1.9.5 print export with the my theme

scripts.build:golden: node bin/md2pdf.js golden/typora-export-test.md -o out/acceptance.pdf --footer "No. ${pageNo} / ${totalPages}" --author 一苇
scripts.build:toc: node bin/md2pdf.js test/toc.md -o out/toc.pdf --footer "No. ${pageNo} / ${totalPages}" --title 目录页码测试
scripts.test:toc: npm run -s build:toc && python tools/toc_check.py out/toc.pdf
scripts.css:audit: node bin/md2pdf.js test/features.md -o out/_css-audit.pdf --html out/audit.html --quiet && node bin/md2pdf.js test/toc.md -o out/_css-audit.pdf --html out/audit-toc.html --quiet && node bin/md2pdf.js test/large.md -o out/_css-audit.pdf --html out/audit-large.html --quiet && node bin/md2pdf.js test/fence.md -o out/_css-audit.pdf --html out/audit-fence.html --quiet && node bin/md2pdf.js golden/typora-export-test.md -o out/_css-audit.pdf --html out/audit-corpus.html --quiet && node tools/css-audit.mjs out/audit.html out/audit-toc.html out/audit-large.html out/audit-fence.html out/audit-corpus.html --json out/css-audit.json
scripts.test: node src/fence/verify.js && node src/math/verify.js && node tools/parity.mjs && node tools/acceptance.mjs && node bin/md2pdf.js test/toc.md -o out/toc.pdf --footer "No. ${pageNo} / ${totalPages}" --title 目录页码测试 --quiet && python tools/toc_check.py out/toc.pdf
scripts.electron:build: node bin/md2pdf.js golden/typora-export-test.md -o out/electron-acceptance.pdf --footer "No. ${pageNo} / ${totalPages}" --author 一苇
scripts.verify:dist: node tools/acceptance.mjs --out out/dist-p1.pdf && python tools/toc_check.py out/dist-p2.pdf
